title: Synthesis record
description: Language-neutral SSOT for the frozen synthesis-record contract (contractVersion 1). One small structured record emitted per synthesizer node (Area, Hub, or Home) and published by a council job to Firestore at users/{uid}/synthesis/{nodeId}, where nodeId is the dotted node path with '/' replaced by '__'. Parents read their children's RECORDS, never the children's raw data. Additive-only evolution: consumers read a fixed subset and ignore unknown fields, so new properties are safe; a rename/removal is the one gated, breaking act.

contractVersion.description: Integer; bumped ONLY on a breaking shape change. Currently 1.

node.description: Dotted tree path in the Pillar > Hub > Area tree (e.g. 'physicals/sleep'), or 'home' for the root Balance node.

producer.description: Which council job/agent emitted this record (e.g. 'council/nightly-light').

producedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp the council stamped when it produced this record.

window.description: The window this record summarizes: either '<ISOdate>..<ISOdate>' (a range) or a single ISO date.

state.description: The node's normalized read: a band bucket plus an integer 0..100 score (or null when there is no data).

band.description: Buckets the score: thriving 80-100, steady 60-79, strained 40-59, depleted 0-39, 'unknown' when score is null / no data.

score.description: Normalized 0..100 health/attention read, computed relative to the node's own target/baseline. null when there is no data (band must then be 'unknown').

headline.description: One-line human summary of the window, <= 140 chars.

signals.description: Top-N evidence strings; the 'discard non-useful info' lever. MAX 5 items.

nudges.description: Prospective suggested moves. Optional; defaults to []. Each item has text plus an integer priority (1 = highest).

provenance.description: What this record was derived from: the contributing sources and how complete the input data was.

sources.description: Identifiers of the inputs this record drew on (child node paths and/or feed names, e.g. 'recovery_state', 'rest_log').

coverage.description: Fraction 0..1 of expected input data that was actually present; lets a parent down-weight a thin-data child.

confidence.description: Guards against over-claiming on thin data.
